written: before any A3 measured-step result (k10 panels still running); instruction of 2026-09-30 night run

existing_criterion_reused.source: docs/GTO_HU_CONTINUATION_V1.md (damped run: 'The fixed point is reached at aggregate level with alpha = 0.5 (frequencies +-0.005 per step)'; class level not required, table change reported against the class CI) and docs/GTO_HU_CONTINUATION_V2.md Stage B (same reading, fixed step count, no new threshold)
existing_criterion_reused.aggregate_fixed_point: every main aggregate frequency changes by <= 0.005 between the last two preflop states
main_aggregates: BB vs BTN open after SB fold (node 28 parent) fold/call/3bet/jam
BB vs SB open (node 6 parent) fold/call/3bet/jam
reported_not_gating: measured mean |dV| per terminal vs the mean class CI half-width
existing_criterion_reused.preflop: fixed 400 iterations as in every earlier step; the gap is recorded; no gap threshold existed and none is added

cases_after_3_measured_steps (P10..P13),.A_converged: max main-aggregate change P12 -> P13 <= 0.005: stop, freeze as the dual-terminal reference (nodes 28 + 6 solved only; not a finished GTO DB)
cases_after_3_measured_steps (P10..P13),.C_period2: for some main aggregate the step changes alternate in sign over P10..P13 AND |P_k - P_(k+2)| < 0.5 * min(|P_k - P_(k+1)|, |P_(k+1) - P_(k+2)|) (the V1 pattern: P2 ~ P4 while adjacent steps stay apart); record, no new alpha, never more than 5 measured steps
cases_after_3_measured_steps (P10..P13),.D_divergence: range L1 (node 28 and node 6, all seats) and measured mean |dV| (both terminals) and the max main-aggregate change all increase over two consecutive steps, or the preflop EV sum grows in absolute value over two consecutive steps: stop, decompose by terminal, no tuning
cases_after_3_measured_steps (P10..P13),.B_decreasing: not A, C or D, and range L1, measured mean |dV| and the max main-aggregate change each decrease step over step: up to 2 more measured steps (total 5, P15), same alpha/fallback; if still not A at P15, seal 'not converged / decreasing'
cases_after_3_measured_steps (P10..P13),.otherwise: seal 'not converged / mixed' after 3 measured steps

hard_stops: NaN / inf in exports or tables
provenance/hash mismatch or determinism break (driver asserts the terminal exports agree bit for bit)
single_flop_cap: a flop that misses the 0.30% target at the 1000-iteration cap is kept (A1 policy), recorded, and the table guard decides
restarts: container restarts are not failures; finished artifacts are reused through the provenance checks
scope_note: added during k10 without changing any rule: the <= 0.005 aggregate criterion decides only whether A3 converged in the same sense as the earlier V1/V2 experiments (research stability). It is NOT a production-DB acceptance criterion; a stricter DB criterion (EV change, strategy change, solver error, conservation, seed stability) is to be designed and fixed separately by the user.
artifact_retention: A3 results and all intermediate artifacts (per-flop solves, measured/used/rejected tables, exports, censuses, logs) are kept until the production-DB decision is finished. After A3 ends: no separate re-run first; the stricter DB acceptance criterion is evaluated on the existing outputs, and only the items it finds insufficient get targeted validation.
